project_name: Spelling Bee Champion - Year 7-12 Practice Web App
target_audience: Year 7-12 Students (Ages 12-18). Scholarly, competitive, sleek, gamified academic arena. Avoid cartoonish/kindergarten visual tropes. Emphasize collegiate prep, spelling tournament prestige, and high-energy word mastery.

theme_strategy.archetype: The Academic Arena & Golden Hive (High-contrast slate black with Amber Gold highlights and Emerald/Indigo status triggers)

dashboard_view.description: Main hub showing championship title, level badge, quick start CTA, active streak, stats breakdown, difficulty selector, and mode selector.
components: Header Navigation with Logo, Mode Toggle, Volume Quick-Control, Settings Icon
Hero Practice Banner with 'Start Championship Practice' primary CTA
Stat Widgets: Words Completed, Current Streak (Fire animation), Accuracy %, Average Time
Difficulty Cards: Easy (Yr 7-8), Medium (Yr 9-10), Hard (Yr 11-12), Extreme (National Bee)
Practice Mode Grid: Classic, 10 Words, 25 Words, Endless, Challenge, Test Mode
Recent Missed Words Quick-Drill Widget

practice_screen.description: Stadium-like focused interface for spelling practice with TTS controls, letter input, and hint access.
components: Stage Header with Progress Bar (e.g., Word 4 of 10), Live Score, Timer (for Challenge/Test Mode)
Audio Controller Card with oversized 'Play Word' pulse button, Speed Selectors (Slow 0.75x, Normal 1.0x, Fast 1.25x), 'Repeat Word' button
Sentence & Context Drawer: 'Use in a sentence' button with audio playback
Spelling Text Input: Monospace typography, character count, auto-focus, Submit button with Enter key support
Word Info Side/Bottom Panel: Definition, Part of Speech, Language of Origin / Etymology, IPA Phonetics
Feedback Overlay Card: Animated Success with confetti or Error diff view comparing user attempt vs correct spelling

results_screen.description: Comprehensive tournament scorecard showing final accuracy, streak summary, missed word review, and retry actions.
components: Score Summary Header with Grade Badge (e.g., S Tier / Master Wordsmith)
Accuracy Circular Progress Meter & Speed Analytics
Missed Words Table with Audio Replay buttons, Phonetic breakdowns, and 'Practice Missed Words' CTA
Share / Export Score Card

progress_analytics_screen.description: Detailed statistics page tracking performance trends, difficulty breakdowns, and mastery curves.
components: Accuracy Over Time Line Chart
Mastery by Word Length & Difficulty Bar Charts
Category Breakdown (Greek origins, Latin roots, French loanwords)
Spelling History Log with Search & Filter

settings_screen.description: Customization portal for speech engine, UI theme, audio speed, auto-advance, and keyboard bindings.
components: SpeechSynthesis Voice Dropdown & Pitch/Rate Sliders with 'Test Voice' preview button
Dark / Light / High Contrast Theme Selectors
Audio Effect Toggles & Sound Volume Slider
Keyboard Shortcuts Cheatsheet (Space = Play audio, Enter = Submit, Tab = Sentence hint)

micro_interactions_and_motion.audio_pulse: Continuous glowing ring animation around Play Word button during audio playback
micro_interactions_and_motion.input_shake: Subtle red horizontal shake animation on incorrect spelling submission
micro_interactions_and_motion.success_glow: Green emerald border flash and micro confetti burst on correct spelling
micro_interactions_and_motion.streak_flame: Animated flame flicker icon when streak exceeds 3 consecutive correct words
micro_interactions_and_motion.card_hover: Hover lift -translate-y-1 with amber border glow transition

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rules: ALL interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, audio controls, stat cards, and text feedback elements MUST include unique kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='play-word-button', data-testid='spelling-input', data-testid='submit-spelling-button', data-testid='difficulty-extreme-card', data-testid='mode-test-mode-card').
testing_and_accessibility.accessibility_standards: Text inputs MUST have clear visual focus rings, aria-labels for TTS audio buttons, shortcut key legends, and WCAG AA contrast for dark slate backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React app with seamless tabbed/view navigation (Dashboard, Practice, Results, Progress, Settings).
Utilize Web Speech API (window.speechSynthesis) for TTS audio playback with robust fallback text or mock audio notification if browser TTS is unavailable.

Implement comprehensive word bank categorized into Year 7-8 (Easy), Year 9-10 (Medium), Year 11-12 (Hard), and Scripps National Level (Extreme). Include definitions, parts of speech, origin, IPA, and sentence context for every word.
Support practice modes: Classic (infinite), 10 Words, 25 Words, Endless (3 lives), Challenge (timed 15s per word), Test Mode (single audio play, no hints, timed exam setup).
Include local storage persistence for user streak, total words completed, accuracy statistics, custom drill list, and settings preferences.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, audio triggers, and stat displays feature clear data-testid attributes for automated testing.
